info.title: instagram (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Instagram Graph API (Content Publishing) via graph.facebook.com. Requires a Facebook Developer App with instagram_content_publish and instagram_basic permissions plus a long-lived User Access Token. Publishing uses a two-step flow: create a media container, then publish it. Rate limits: 400 containers per 24-hour rolling period; 50 published posts per 24-hour moving period.

post.summary: First step of the publishing flow: create a media container (image, reel, carousel, or story) that will be used when pub
post.description: First step of the publishing flow: create a media container (image, reel, carousel, or story) that will be used when publishing the post. For a single photo, supply image_url. For a reel or video, supply video_url and media_type=REELS. For a story, set media_type=STORIES. For individual carousel items, set is_carousel_item=true. For the carousel wrapper, set media_type=CAROUSEL and include a children array of container IDs.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The Instagram Business Account ID to create the container under.

requestBody.description: Body: {image_url (string â€” publicly accessible image URL, required for images), video_url (string â€” publicly accessible video URL, required for videos and reels), media_type (string â€” required for CAROUSEL/REELS/STORIES; enum: 'CAROUSEL'|'REELS'|'STORIES'), caption (optional, string â€” max 2200 chars, 30 hashtags, 20 @ tags; not supported on carousel items), alt_text (optional, string â€” alternative text for images, max 1000 chars; not supported on reels or stories), location_id (optional, string â€” Facebook Pages page ID to tag location; not supported on carousel items), user_tags (optional, array â€” [{username: string, x: float 0.0-1.0, y: float 0.0-1.0}]; x and y required for images, optional for stories), is_carousel_item (optional, boolean â€” set true when creating individual carousel item containers), children (optional, array of strings â€” container IDs for carousel items, required when media_type is CAROUSEL, 2-10 items), cover_url (optional, string â€” image URL for reel cover photo; for reels only), thumb_offset (optional, integer â€” millisecond offset for video thumbnail frame, default 0; for videos and reels), share_to_feed (optional, boolean â€” when true the reel can appear in both Feed and Reels tabs; for reels only), audio_name (optional, string â€” name for the reel audio; for reels only, can only be set once), collaborators (optional, array of strings â€” up to 3 Instagram usernames as collaborators; for feed images, reels, and carousels only)}

post.summary: Second step of the publishing flow: publish a container that was created in step 1. For single photos: create the contai
post.description: Second step of the publishing flow: publish a container that was created in step 1. For single photos: create the container then call this endpoint. For carousels: create each item container, create the carousel wrapper with a children array, then call this endpoint.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The Instagram Business Account ID to publish under.

requestBody.description: Body: {creation_id (required, string â€” the container ID obtained from the media container creation step)}

get.summary: Check the processing status of a media container created in step 1. Poll this endpoint until status_code returns FINISHE
get.description: Check the processing status of a media container created in step 1. Poll this endpoint until status_code returns FINISHED before proceeding to media_publish. This step is mandatory for video and reel containers, which require processing time.

parameters.name: containerId
parameters.description: The container ID returned by the createContainer operation.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names to include in the response (e.g. 'id,status_code,status').

200.description: {id, status_code: 'EXPIRED'|'ERROR'|'FINISHED'|'IN_PROGRESS'|'PUBLISHED', status (string â€” human-readable status message, present on ERROR)}

get.summary: Retrieve fields from a published Instagram media object. Can also be used to poll container status by requesting status_
get.description: Retrieve fields from a published Instagram media object. Can also be used to poll container status by requesting status_code in the fields parameter.

parameters.name: mediaId
parameters.description: The media object ID or container ID to query.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to return. For published media: id, media_type, media_url, caption, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, like_count, comments_count, shortcode, is_comment_enabled, is_shared_to_feed, alt_text. For containers: id, status_code, status.

200.description: For media: {id, media_type, media_url, caption, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, like_count, comments_count, shortcode, is_comment_enabled, is_shared_to_feed, alt_text}. For containers: {id, status_code: 'EXPIRED'|'ERROR'|'FINISHED'|'IN_PROGRESS'|'PUBLISHED', status}

Media.description: A media object representing a post that has been published to Instagram.

id.description: Unique identifier for the media object.

media_type.description: The category of media this object represents.

media_url.description: Direct URL pointing to the media file.

caption.description: Text caption on the post (up to 2200 characters, 30 hashtags, 20 @ tags).

permalink.description: Stable, permanent URL pointing to the published post.

thumbnail_url.description: Preview thumbnail URL. Applies only to VIDEO media.

timestamp.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format, expressed in UTC.

username.description: The Instagram handle of the account that published this media.

like_count.description: Total number of likes on this media.

comments_count.description: Total number of comments on this media.

shortcode.description: Short alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the post.

is_comment_enabled.description: Indicates whether users can currently comment on this post.

is_shared_to_feed.description: Reels only: whether this reel is eligible to surface in the Feed tab alongside the Reels tab.

alt_text.description: Accessibility text describing the image content.
